title: Wire deployment_trace table population into RecordDeployment

title: Design study: slot-based composition model
description: Produce a design study (per folio standards) for an 'output slot' abstraction that replaces type-convention-driven deployment. Each slot declaratively specifies: source entries (cross-type), composition primitive, and destination path. Unifies OMP config deployment (to .omp/ paths) and OS config deployment (to OS paths like ~/.zshrc) under one mechanism. Addresses the current limitation where destination path is rigidly derived from source-type conventions.

title: Implement carrel os-setup command

Resolves OS config entries from sources, composes them, deploys to container OS paths (~/.zshrc, ~/.config/nvim/init.lua, ~/.config/wezterm/wezterm.lua). Consumer is the container (ConsumerContainer). May depend on slot-based composition model for destination path mapping.

This ensures carrel sources and carrel run work immediately after bootstrap without manual entry registration.
